title: Strategy & Planning Manager
description:
Job Summary Meet the Team. Join Cisco's Global Supply Chain Strategy & Planning team, an internal consulting organization focused on solving the most complex, cross-functional supply chain challenges that span multiple functions. The team takes ambiguous business problems from problem framing through analysis, recommendation, and leadership decision-making. Recent engagements have included designing operating models for new fulfillment capabilities, benchmarking Cisco against competitors, and building analytical business cases for significant inventory and sourcing decisions. Responsibilities As a Strategy & Planning Manager, you will own a workstream within a larger strategic engagement and work closely with the Engagement Lead. You will be accountable for structuring the problem, leading the analysis, engaging stakeholders, and developing a clear recommendation that leadership can act on. You will combine quantitative analysis, business judgment, external benchmarking, and stakeholder management to develop a point of view, clearly articulate trade-offs, and influence senior leaders toward informed decisions. You will own a workstream end-to-end, from problem definition and structuring through analysis and final recommendation. You will build the quantitative analysis that underpins strategic decisions, including financial models, scenarios, business cases, and analytical frameworks, using clearly defined assumptions where data is incomplete. You will independently manage stakeholder relationships across Business Units, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, and Finance, bringing together conflicting inputs and driving alignment without unnecessary escalation. You will conduct external benchmarking and competitive analysis where relevant, translating findings into clear implications and recommendations for Cisco. You will develop and defend a clear point of view, articulate key trade-offs, and confidently respond to challenge from senior stakeholders. You will present your workstream findings to senior leaders and contribute to the broader engagement storyline and recommendation. You will guide analysts supporting your workstream by reviewing their analysis, strengthening problem structuring, and developing their communication and presentation skills. You will collaborate with Business Units, Supply Chain Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, Finance, and senior business stakeholders across Cisco. You will also work closely with the broader Strategy & Planning team and Engagement Leads on cross-functional strategic engagements. You are a structured, analytical, and commercially minded problem solver who is comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information. You can quickly break down open-ended problems, determine the key questions that need to be answered, build a fact base, and turn analysis into a clear recommendation. You are confident working directly with senior stakeholders, can navigate conflicting perspectives, and are comfortable defending your point of view with data and business logic. You communicate top-down and answer-first, ensuring that your recommendations are clear, concise, and actionable. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or supply chain operations. Proven experience owning workstreams from problem definition through completion. Demonstrated ability to structure open-ended and loosely defined business problems into an actionable analytical framework. Strong ability to build quantitative models from incomplete data using clearly stated assumptions. Experience independently managing relationships with senior stakeholders. Strong ability to communicate top-down and lead with the answer rather than the analysis. Demonstrated ability to form, communicate, and defend a recommendation under challenge. Preferred Qualifications Experience in operations or supply chain consulting, particularly in operating model design, inventory, network design, or process improvement. Experience mentoring, coaching, or reviewing the work of junior analysts. Experience with analytical tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau. Experience working across global teams, geographies, and time zones.

title: Sr Mgr ACD
description:
About us: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of Americas leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and youll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. Overview about TII At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company s global strategy and operations. 
 Target Creative s Brand Design Lab (BDL) is the in-house creative team dedicated to building and bringing Target s owned brands to life. Working as one integrated team across the U.S. and India, BDL develops differentiated brand identities, packaging systems and creative expressions that connect strategy, design and storytelling across Target s portfolio. Some of the brands we have built include Good & Gather, up&up, Hearth & Hand, Cat & Jack, Kindfull and Goodfellow & Co. 
 About this Opportunity As a Sr. Manager, Associate Creative Director , you will play a key role in shaping how Target s owned brands show up through design. You will guide creative teams, establish a strong point of view and ensure our work is distinctive, relevant and unmistakably Target. Your impact will extend beyond individual projects. You will raise the standard of creative work, make thoughtful and confident creative decisions, grow talent and use design to influence broader brand and business outcomes. Working across Target s global organization, you will bring together strategy, creativity and craft to build meaningful brand experiences for our guests. What You ll Do Establish the creative vision and guide teams in building distinctive brand identities, packaging and design systems. Set a consistently high standard for creative thinking, design quality and craft across the work. Turn brand strategy, business priorities and guest insights into meaningful creative ideas and design solutions. Guide the work from early-stage thinking and concept development through design execution and production. Make confident creative decisions and give clear, timely and actionable feedback that moves the work forward. Build strong creative teams and actively coach, mentor and develop the next generation of creative leaders. Oversee multiple complex initiatives, creating focus and making thoughtful decisions across priorities, resources and timelines. Partner closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Packaging, Product Development and Project Management across global teams. Build alignment and influence outcomes by clearly articulating creative thinking, rationale and recommendations. Stay connected to Target s business, guests, culture, categories and the broader design landscape to bring fresh thinking into the work. Look beyond individual assignments to identify opportunities to strengthen our brands, creative capabilities and ways of working. What You ll Bring 15+ years of experience across brand design, packaging and/or creative direction. A strong portfolio demonstrating depth of thinking and excellence across brand identity, packaging and design systems. A highly evolved creative eye and strong judgment across brand, design and craft. Experience guiding multidisciplinary creative teams and delivering complex creative programs from idea through execution. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex creative thinking clear and compelling. The ability to see the bigger picture and connect creative choices to brand strategy, guest needs and business priorities. A track record of coaching and developing creative talent and helping others do their best work. Confidence working through ambiguity, setting direction and making decisions when there isn t an obvious answer. The ability to build credibility and strong relationships across disciplines, levels, cultures and global teams. Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, production processes and emerging tools and technologies. Curiosity, adaptability and a desire to continuously learn and evolve as a creative leader.
 What Success Looks Like You elevate the quality of the work and the thinking behind it. You create clarity and momentum for teams. You grow people and future leaders. You build trust across the organization and connect creative ambition to what matters for our guests and the business. Most importantly, you create an environment where strong ideas, great design and talented people can flourish.
